discoveries.discovery: Copying project.ts template exactly enables 4-minute implementation

discoveries.lesson: When new code mirrors existing code, copy and adapt the template

discoveries.discovery: Drizzle inArray enables efficient bulk operations
discoveries.context: Need to update status for multiple features at once
discoveries.lesson: Use inArray(column, ids) for bulk operations
